title: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page

entries.text: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page. Remember the choice between visits, and follow the system theme until someone picks one.
Claude writes, ChatGPT reviews (up to 3 rounds).
Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page. Remember the choice between visits, and follow the system theme until someone picks one.
I'll look at how settings are laid out and where styles are applied before adding the toggle.

Added a **Theme** row to the settings page with System, Light and Dark choices.

- `src/theme.ts` reads the saved choice from `localStorage` and falls back to `prefers-color-scheme`.
- `src/settings.tsx` shows the choice as a segmented control and applies it at once.
- `tests/theme.test.ts` covers the saved choice, the system fallback and switching back to System.

`npm test` passes (14 tests).

Review the change.
I'll read the diff and run the tests myself rather than relying on the report.

Two findings; the rest looks right.

- **F1** `src/theme.ts:18` The `prefers-color-scheme` listener is added on every render and never removed, so switching pages piles up listeners.
- **F2** `src/settings.tsx:42` The segmented control has no accessible label; a screen reader announces three unlabeled buttons.

Not approved yet.
